ProgramUnit.Name: DUP_RECORD_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE dup_record_check IS
 counter NUMBER;
 chk NUMBER;
BEGIN
 if :global.match_a1a1 != :viu_block.match_a1a1 or
 :global.match_a1a2 != :viu_block.match_a1a2 or
 :global.match_a2a1 != :viu_block.match_a2a1 or
 :global.match_a2a2 != :viu_block.match_a2a2 then
 check_insert_rg('CRG_VALID','C05C05C05C05',
 :global.match_a1a1||','||
 :global.match_a1a2||','||
 :global.match_a2a1||','||
 :global.match_a2a2||
 ',','D',chk);
 end if;
-- message('in dup check');pause;
 if :global.match_a1a1 = :viu_block.match_a1a1 and
 :global.match_a1a2 = :viu_block.match_a1a2 and
 :global.match_a2a1 = :viu_block.match_a2a1 and
 :global.match_a2a2 = :viu_block.match_a2a2 
 then
 null;
ELSE 
 if :viu_block.match_a1a1 is not null and
 :viu_block.match_a1a2 is not null and
 :viu_block.match_a2a1 is not null and
 :viu_block.match_a2a2 is not null then
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO counter
 FROM hla_interim_match
 WHERE match_a1a1 = :viu_block.match_a1a1 and
 match_a1a2 = :viu_block.match_a1a2 and
 match_a2a1 = :viu_block.match_a2a1 and
 match_a2a2 = :viu_block.match_a2a2;
 -- message(to_char(counter)||:system.record_status);pause;
 if :system.record_status = 'INSERT' then 
 if counter > 0 then 
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 check_package_failure;
 else 
 check_insert_rg('CRG_VALID','C05C05C05C05',
 :viu_block.match_a1a1||','||
 :viu_block.match_a1a2||','||
 :viu_block.match_a2a1||','||
 :viu_block.match_a2a2||
 ',','U',chk);
 IF chk >= 1 THEN
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 end if;
 end if;

 if :system.record_status = 'CHANGED' then
 if counter >= 1 then
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 check_insert_rg('CRG_VALID','C05C05C05C05',
 :viu_block.match_a1a1||','||
 :viu_block.match_a1a2||','||
 :viu_block.match_a2a1||','||
 :viu_block.match_a2a2||
 ',','U',chk);
 IF chk >= 1 THEN
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 end if;
 END IF; /* record status check end*/
 end if; /* 1st if then */
END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_EFF_TERM_DATES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE validate_eff_term_dates ( eff_date in date,
 term_date in date,
 from_where in varchar2 ) 
IS
dt_chk boolean;
begin
 if eff_date is null then
 show_error('5002');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if eff_date < trunc(sysdate) and from_where = 'E' then
 show_error('5015');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;

 if term_date is not null then
 if term_date < trunc(sysdate) then
 show_error('3115');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 dt_chk := check_from_to_date(eff_date,term_date);
 if dt_chk then
 null;
 else
 --message('Err. Term date is before effective date.');
 --raise form_trigger_failure;
 show_error('5004');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: SET_CONTROL_BLOCK_ITEMS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE set_control_block_items(action IN varchar2) IS
BEGIN
 if :system.cursor_item != 'CTRL_BLOCK.MATCH_A1A1' then
 item_change('ctrl_block.match_a1a1',action);
 end if;
 if :system.cursor_item != 'CTRL_BLOCK.MATCH_A1A2' then
 item_change('ctrl_block.match_a1a2',action);
 end if;
 if :system.cursor_item != 'CTRL_BLOCK.MATCH_A2A1' then
 item_change('ctrl_block.match_a2a1',action);
 end if;
 if :system.cursor_item != 'CTRL_BLOCK.MATCH_A2A2' then
 item_change('ctrl_block.match_a2a2',action);
 end if;


 item_change('ctrl_block.pb_retrieve',action);
 item_change('ctrl_block.pb_match_a1a1',action);
 item_change('ctrl_block.pb_match_a1a2',action); 
 item_change('ctrl_block.pb_match_a2a1',action); 
 item_change('ctrl_block.pb_match_a2a2',action); 

 if action = 'E' then
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_match_a1a1',NAVIGABLE,property_false);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_match_a1a2',NAVIGABLE,property_false);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_match_a2a1',NAVIGABLE,property_false);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_match_a2a2',NAVIGABLE,property_false);
 end if;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: RETREIVE_DATA
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE retreive_data IS
 chk boolean;
 q_str varchar2(200);
begin
if :ctrl_block.match_a1a1 is not null then
 q_str := ' match_a1a1 = :ctrl_block.match_a1a1 ';
end if;
if :ctrl_block.match_a1a2 is not null then
 if q_str is not null then
 q_str := q_str||' and match_a1a2 = :ctrl_block.match_a1a2 ';
 else
 q_str := ' match_a1a2 = :ctrl_block.match_a1a2 ';
 end if;
end if;
if :ctrl_block.match_a2a1 is not null then
 if q_str is not null then
 q_str := q_str||' and match_a2a1 = :ctrl_block.match_a2a1 ';
 else
 q_str := ' match_a2a1 = :ctrl_block.match_a2a1 ';
 end if;
end if;
if :ctrl_block.match_a2a2 is not null then
 if q_str is not null then
 q_str := q_str||' and match_a2a2 = :ctrl_block.match_a2a2 ';
 else
 q_str := ' match_a2a2 = :ctrl_block.match_a2a2 ';
 end if;
end if;
set_block_property('viu_block',DEFAULT_WHERE,q_str);

go_block('viu_block');
execute_query;
set_block_property('viu_block',DEFAULT_WHERE,'');
go_block('viu_block');

end;
